{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
revenue_clean = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from loyal customers AND exclude QA orders
filtered_data = data[  
    (data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &  
    (data['status'] == 'completed') &
    (revenue_clean != 999999.99)  
]

# Recalculate revenue as float after filtering
filtered_revenue = filtered_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = filtered_revenue.mean()

# Output
print(f"Number of loyal, completed, non-QA orders: {len(filtered_revenue)}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
